Lemma
[A Nondegenerate Tuple of Full Length is a Basis]

↗ lem:nondegenerate-tuple-independent

In an $n$-dimensional scalar product space, every nondegenerate $n$-tuple is a basis.

Proof

↗ lem:nondegenerate-tuple-independent \sketch It is an independent family of $n=\dim V$ vectors.

□
